questions.question: What is the primary benefit of multi-stage Docker builds?
options: They eliminate the need for an operating system kernel
They keep compilers and source code out of the final production image
They allow running Windows containers directly on Linux
They automatically push images to Docker Hub
questions.explanation: Multi-stage builds allow developers to compile artifacts in a heavy build stage and copy only the compiled binary into a minimal runtime image.

questions.question: Why should `package.json` or `go.mod` be copied before the rest of the application code?
options: To maximize Docker layer caching and avoid re-downloading dependencies on code changes
questions.explanation: Copying dependency manifests first ensures that dependencies are cached unless the manifest itself changes.
